sentences.note: The sentence puts five audit scale names in the middle, then adds two clauses.
sentences.text: Five audit scales — Macro-A cross-repo strategy, Macro-B repo quadrant, Macro-C evolution archaeology, Micro-A PR diff, Micro-B file level — share one fact base and one adjudication layer, and differ in triggers and report slices.
sentences.raw: Five audit scales — Macro-A cross-repo strategy, Macro-B repo quadrant, Macro-C evolution archaeology, Micro-A PR diff, Micro-B file level — share one fact base and one adjudication layer, and differ in triggers and report slices.
sentences.source_line: 6F is a macro + micro engineering-content audit product for git-healthy repositories, distributed as a **Claude Code Agent Plugin** ([`engine/`](engine/)). Evidence collection comes largely from upstream components; the adjudication protocol, fact-table schema, acceptance gates, and verifiable receipts are this project's own work. Five audit scales — Macro-A cross-repo strategy, Macro-B repo quadrant, Macro-C evolution archaeology, Micro-A PR diff, Micro-B file level — share one fact base and one adjudication layer, and differ in triggers and report slices.

sentences.label: English B
sentences.note: One sentence carries two actions with a semicolon, then adds a loopback-only condition.
sentences.text: The proxy engine is the Resin sidecar v1.2.0; scripts/fetch_resin.sh pulls its binary from the upstream Release at build time, and the shell reaches it only over a loopback REST seam.
sentences.raw: The proxy engine is the Resin sidecar v1.2.0; [`scripts/fetch_resin.sh`](scripts/fetch_resin.sh) pulls its binary from the upstream Release at build time, and the shell reaches it only over a loopback REST seam.
sentences.source_line: A single unified proxy cannot carry per-key identity for HTTPS upstreams (the CONNECT tunnel hides the destination), so multi-port is the correct identity mechanism. The shell backend core is `crates/resin-core` (Rust: tokio, reqwest, rusqlite). The proxy engine is the Resin sidecar v1.2.0; [`scripts/fetch_resin.sh`](scripts/fetch_resin.sh) pulls its binary from the upstream Release at build time, and the shell reaches it only over a loopback REST seam. The `resin/` directory on disk is a gitignored local reference clone, not part of the repo.

dashes.label: English example 1: supplement at the end
dashes.text: It exposes many socks5/http entry ports; each port is the identity of one (platform, account) pair, and a Resin Go sidecar guarantees a distinct sticky exit IP per pair — one AI API key never shares an egress IP with another unless you decide it should.
dashes.raw: It exposes many socks5/http entry ports; each port is the identity of one (platform, account) pair, and a Resin Go sidecar guarantees a distinct sticky exit IP per pair — one AI API key never shares an egress IP with another unless you decide it should.
dashes.plain: The semicolon part has already made the main point. The dash adds a condition: one key does not share an exit IP with another.
dashes.why: This dash works like parentheses: it adds a condition, not a turn.
dashes.source_line: EgressAPIKEY is a desktop application (Tauri 2 + React 19) that sits between your AI gateway (OmniRoute / LiteLLM / CLIProxy) and upstream OpenAI-compatible v1 providers. It exposes many socks5/http entry ports; each port is the identity of one (platform, account) pair, and a Resin Go sidecar guarantees a distinct sticky exit IP per pair — one AI API key never shares an egress IP with another unless you decide it should.

dashes.label: English example 2: label followed by an explanation
dashes.text: Forensics — evolution archaeology digs repository history into evidence (Macro-C).
dashes.raw: **Forensics** — evolution archaeology digs repository history into evidence (Macro-C).
dashes.plain: Before the dash there is only the label Forensics; the explanation comes after it.
dashes.why: A label followed by an explanation reads more like a colon.
dashes.source_line: - **Forensics** — evolution archaeology digs repository history into evidence (Macro-C).

dashes.label: 中文例：破折号后面接例外
dashes.text: 它暴露多个 socks5/http 入口端口；每个端口即一个（平台，账户）身份对的标识，Resin Go 侧车保证每一对都拥有独立的粘性出口 IP —— 除非你明确允许，一个 AI API Key 绝不与其他 Key 共享出口 IP。
dashes.raw: 它暴露多个 socks5/http 入口端口；每个端口即一个（平台，账户）身份对的标识，Resin Go 侧车保证每一对都拥有独立的粘性出口 IP —— 除非你明确允许，一个 AI API Key 绝不与其他 Key 共享出口 IP。
dashes.plain: The first half says each pair has its own exit IP. The part after the dash adds an exception.
dashes.why: This is the common Chinese form where the dash introduces an exception. A comma or parentheses would need the sentence rebuilt.
dashes.source_line: EgressAPIKEY 是一款桌面应用（Tauri 2 + React 19），位于你的 AI 网关（OmniRoute / LiteLLM / CLIProxy）与上游 OpenAI 兼容 v1 服务商之间。它暴露多个 socks5/http 入口端口；每个端口即一个（平台，账户）身份对的标识，Resin Go 侧车保证每一对都拥有独立的粘性出口 IP —— 除非你明确允许，一个 AI API Key 绝不与其他 Key 共享出口 IP。

pairs.label: 中文 before/after
pairs.before: 单一统一代理无法为 HTTPS 上游携带按 Key 的身份（CONNECT 隧道对目的地不可见），因此多端口才是正确的身份机制。
pairs.raw: 单一统一代理无法为 HTTPS 上游携带按 Key 的身份（CONNECT 隧道对目的地不可见），因此多端口才是正确的身份机制。
pairs.after: 一个代理没法让不同的 Key 用不同身份：HTTPS 隧道里看不见目的地。所以要按 Key 开多个端口，一个端口一个身份。
pairs.why: Replace 携带按 Key 的身份 with 让不同的 Key 用不同身份, and split the conclusion after 因此 into its own sentence.
pairs.source_line: 单一统一代理无法为 HTTPS 上游携带按 Key 的身份（CONNECT 隧道对目的地不可见），因此多端口才是正确的身份机制。壳侧后端核心是 `crates/resin-core`（Rust：tokio、reqwest、rusqlite）；代理引擎是 Resin 侧车 v1.2.0，仅通过环回 REST 接缝访问，构建期由 [`scripts/fetch_resin.sh`](scripts/fetch_resin.sh) 从上游 Release 拉取二进制。磁盘上的 `resin/` 目录是 gitignored 的本地参考克隆，不属于本仓库。

pairs.label: English before/after
pairs.before: An orchestration skill for README governance. One entry point sequences upstream skills across audit, improve, and rewrite — every claim in the result is checked against what the repository can actually verify with a receipt.
pairs.raw: An orchestration skill for README governance. One entry point sequences upstream skills across `audit`, `improve`, and `rewrite` — every claim in the result is checked against what the repository can actually verify with a receipt.
pairs.after: A skill that checks and rewrites README files. It calls existing skills for audit, improve and rewrite; every claim in the result must point to evidence the repository really has.
pairs.why: Replace orchestration skill for README governance with a skill that checks and rewrites README files, and replace checked against what the repository can actually verify with must point to evidence the repository really has.
